scope: Corollary 12.4 (Complete and chronological conditioning) of the manuscript “Random coordinate frames and partial permutation laws” (preprints/Random-coordinate-frames-and-partial-permutation-laws-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0a520da2d4a92a17), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 41. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Fix integers T ≥ 1 and 1 ≤ q ≤ n. Let v = (v1, . . . , vT ) be a random schedule of nonzero directions. Set Z0 = I, and suppose that, conditional on v, the increments of Z are independent uniform switches in directions v1, . . . , vT . Let C = (c1, . . . , cq) be a deterministic list of distinct labels, or a random such list independent of the joint process (v, (Zt)T t=0). For 1 ≤ j ≤ q, put FC,j t = σ C, v1, . . . , vt, Zs(ci) : 0 ≤ s ≤ t, i < j  , (12.2) HC,j = σ C, v, Zs(ci) : 0 ≤ s ≤ T, i < j  . (12.3) For 0 ≤ t ≤ T, define pt(x) = Pr{Zt(cj) = x | FC,j t }. Then, for every x ∈ V , Pr{Zt(cj) = x | HC,j } = pt(x) almost surely. (12.4) For t < T, let Kt(v) = Pr{vt+1 = v | v1, . . . , vt}. Then Pr{Zt(cj) = x, vt+1 = v | FC,j t } = pt(x)Kt(v). (12.5)
